in_marathi.name: Shivin
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे God of Destruction and Regeneration
in_marathi.long_meaning: Shivin हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Shivin is a Hindu name that means 'God of Destruction and Regeneration'. This name is derived from the name of the Hindu deity Shiva, who is the god of destruction, regeneration, and transformation. Shiva is also known as the god of time, as well as the god of dance, music, and arts. In Hindu mythology, Shiva is depicted as having three eyes and a third eye on his forehead, which represents wisdom and the ability to see the past, present, and future.
